main_text.p: qui non cum his ipsis, sed cum civitate fœdus percuterent. Inveni etiam hoc collegium colligendis in agro tributis, si quando tributis, opus, præfuisse, eamque pecuniam tractasse, aggerum, viarum, aquæductuum curam habuisse, judices agrarios ad faciendum officium compulisse, exorbitantesque eosdem compressise, ad conventus ordines convocasse, denique velut ad clavum Reip. sedentes, quietis & εὐζωΐας[?] custodes in tota provincia fuisse. Et hæc ad SAXONUM usque tempora. Ii partim sua sponte, partim stimulantibus nonnullis, qui ferre imperium non poterant, hac potestate spoliare civitatem conati sunt. E D-SARDUS jus hoc in arctum redegit[?] : quippe sui arbitrii electionemHovetman-norum ex civium numero fecit, & jurisdictionem angustioribus terminis clausit. GELDRUS electionem senatui reddidit, & jurisdictionem restituit solitam, sed quatuor Hovetmannis à senatu lectis[?] ex suis addidit quintum, qui præses collegii esset, ac legatus ipsius, atque hi omnes ipsius quoque homine, atque i-

page.notes: Small caps rendered as capitals: E D- (line-end break of EDSARDUS), SARDUS, GELDRUS, SAXONUM. Greek word after "quietis &" is doubtful in its accents and breathings; the transcription is best reading. A dark blotch sits over "redegit" and may hide part of the word; "lectis" is a best reading of a worn word. The catchword's first letter is cut off at the edge of the scan. The printed missing space in "electionemHovetman-" is left as printed. The running head is in italic-like type in the scan. The page number is printed at the top right. The watermark in the lower right corner is a digitiser's mark and is omitted.
